frame.meaning: the entity is a coordinate system: dims, units, and a declared transform to a parent frame, chaining to the primary frame that alone says what one integer step is worth

pose.meaning: the entity has a position, and optionally a heading counter-clockwise from +x, stated in the frame it names

region.meaning: the entity is a bounded area in a frame — a rectangle in v0, anchored at its minimum corner

cell.meaning: the entity is a node an agent can occupy: a footprint and the classes physically able to traverse it; not a tile of any global lattice

tiling.meaning: the entity has generator behaviour over its region: derive cells at a pitch, each carrying the component map in `derives`

flow.meaning: the entity has direction policy over its cell_grid's cells, compiled into edges; absence means unrestricted, so flow restricts and never permits

stitch.meaning: the entity is a declared linking rule between two expansions' cells, by contact within a tolerance or by explicit pairs; nothing links without one

highway.meaning: the cell is on a through-lane: a marker the Walmart maps' tilings stamp beside cell, carrying no fields; not a protocol component

pick.meaning: the entity is a pick place: an operator takes goods out of an inventory carrier presented beside them and puts those goods into the carrier an HTM is holding out here; no fields, the presentation_point on the same cell says which carrier is held out

induct.meaning: the entity is an induct place: an operator puts goods into a carrier presented beside them here — the opposite direction from pick, the same shape, and no fields for the same reason

external_ids.meaning: the entity has the identifiers other systems and sources use for it — a legacy system's, or a site template's key for what made it — carried as data: joinable, never identity, never a reference target

rack.meaning: the entity is one bay of racking, pure steel: a footprint, the slot array, and one enumerated list of level heights bottom-up; it derives its relays and slots

relay.meaning: the entity is one handoff shelf where carriers change hands between the rack system and the floor, carrying the offset on the bay that placed it

access.meaning: the entity is the junction between a run and the region it is worked from: the rack, the region along it, the face storage is reached from, and the classes it serves

access_cell.meaning: the relay has a bound cell — the one an HTM occupies to exchange with it, found as the nearest cell centre within the relay level's reach, or stated by an override

slot.meaning: the entity is one storage position in a rack: a level index into the rack's levels, a column and a depth

storage.meaning: the entity has capacity to hold: what it holds, inventory or order, and optionally which carrier type

station.meaning: the entity is a workstation: a kind — pick, put, induct or extract — and the role that names the product it is

queue.meaning: the entity is a queue: an ordered path of cell addresses with a discipline; the path is the admission, so what the queue holds is the cells it declares

port.meaning: the entity is a boundary point where things enter or leave the world: a direction, what crosses, and the timing

template.meaning: the entity is a packaged, parameterised sub-world of local-handle entities, instantiated by stamps

stamp.meaning: the entity is one placed instance of a template, optionally repeated; it always expands through instance:{i}

robot_class.meaning: the entity is a unit of fleet capability: model and configuration, locomotion, footprint, height and speeds — who made it and who rebranded it ride in lineage

cohort.meaning: the entity is N robots of one class plus an assignment policy; it derives robot:{i}

robot.meaning: the entity is one robot: the class it is an instance of, and its assignment

carrier.meaning: the entity is one carrier: its type, its permanent designation, and its placement

carrier_type.meaning: the entity is a kind of thing that rides an agent and holds merchandise — tote, tray or box — with its geometry and behaviour

carrier_pool.meaning: the entity is a population of carriers of one type and designation with a placement rule; it derives carrier:{i}

charging.meaning: the cell is a robot charging point: a marker with no fields, declared individually or through a tiling's derives; it denotes charging equipment, not a generic idle destination

lineage.meaning: the entity has a provenance: an ordered list, origin first, of who made this product, who rebranded it, and what was fitted to it

waiting.meaning: the entity is a holding pool whose capacity is its cell count — in-task holding at a station, a different fact from parking

presentation_point.meaning: the entity is where a carrier is presented to an operator

sector.meaning: the entity is a shapeless named grouping — explicit member refs, a region, or both — used as a selector for behaviours

demand.meaning: the entity is a workload source bound into a scenario: external data with column semantics, or synthetic parameters

easyloop.meaning: the entity is a GreyOrange EasyLoop pick station, carrying the loop transit and per-pick timings that run it
